data.code:
def policy(obs,P):
 x=obs[0]
 y=obs[1]
 vx=obs[2]
 vy=obs[3]
 angle=obs[4]
 ang_v=obs[5]
 ll=obs[6]
 lr=obs[7]
 des=vx*P["vx_gain"]
 err=angle-des
 if ang_v > P["av_pos"]:
  return 3
 if ang_v < P["av_neg"] and vy < P["vy_left"]:
  return 1
 if vy < P["vy_main"]:
  return 2
 if err > P["ang_dead"]:
  return 3
 if err < -P["ang_dead"]:
  return 1
 return 0
